description: Full official name of the funding organization (the lookup is matched on this or donor_short against the RFP's funder).
Short name / acronym used as the join key when the scanner matches a scanned RFP's funder to this matrix row.
yes = non-profit / NGO entities may apply as the PRIME applicant. no = NGOs cannot lead (feeds PREFER 8 / eligibility).
yes = for-profit / commercial entities may apply as prime. (Informational; some donors are non-profit-only.)
yes = the applicant must be legally registered in the country where the work happens.

yes = applicant must have a locally-constituted Board of Directors in-country. HARD DISQUALIFIER when our org config org_has_local_board = no (your past disqualification: a branch with no local board).
yes = the submission must carry sign-off from an authorized organizational signatory (legal rep / Country Director) with evidence of authority. (Wellcome, GiveWell = yes; Gates = no.)
yes = a government endorsement / no-objection letter is a required part of the application package (and a feasibility dependency that can delay submission).
yes = proof of tax-exempt / charitable status (e.g. US 501(c)(3) or local equivalent) is required.
yes = registration in SAM.gov plus a UEI is required (US federal grants). Registration has lead time, so this also affects MUST 5 timeline.
yes = demonstrated past performance / prior experience in the area is required to be eligible or competitive.
yes = the applicant MUST partner / form a consortium (cannot apply alone). Drives PREFER 8 = False. no = can apply alone or partner optionally → PREFER 8 True.
yes = a specific in-country / local partner is required (distinct from a general consortium).

none | partial | reimbursement_only. none = donor advances funds (best cash flow). partial = part advance. reimbursement_only = we must pre-finance and are reimbursed later. Feeds MUST 4: reimbursement_only -> Partial.
yes = the applicant must contribute co-financing / matching funds.
yes = audited financial statements (typically last 1-3 years) must be submitted with the application.
yes = ethics / Institutional Review Board approval is required (research-heavy opportunities). Tightens MUST 4 Compliant.
yes = a short first-stage concept note is required (often before an invited full proposal). See two_stage_application.
yes = a full technical / narrative proposal is required.
yes = a detailed line-item budget is required.
yes = a budget justification / narrative explaining each cost is required.
yes = a logical framework or results framework (objectives -> indicators -> targets) is required.
yes = a theory of change is required.
yes = an implementation workplan / timeline (e.g. Gantt) is required.
yes = a monitoring & evaluation (M&E) plan is required.
yes = CVs / bios of key personnel are required.
yes = an organizational capacity / capability statement (track record + systems) is required.
yes = letters of support from stakeholders / beneficiaries / government are required.
yes = signed MOUs or commitment letters from partners are required.
yes = a certificate of incorporation / legal registration document is required.
yes = bank account details or a bank information form are required.
yes = the donor's pre-award due-diligence / organizational assessment questionnaire must be completed.
yes = a safeguarding policy (PSEA / child protection) must be provided.
yes = a data management / data protection plan is required.
yes = a risk assessment / mitigation plan is required.
yes = a sustainability / exit / continuation plan is required.
yes = a gender equality & social inclusion (GESI) plan is required.
yes = environmental safeguards / assessment is required.
yes = a procurement plan is required.
yes = an organizational chart / staffing plan for the project is required.

yes = a recent external audit report (e.g. US Single Audit / Uniform Guidance) is required. (Distinct from audited_financials_required, which is the statements themselves; merge if your donors treat them as one.)
yes = professional references / referees are required.
yes = the process is two-stage (concept note first
column3: then invited full proposal). Affects effort and timeline.
